subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence & transfer options for Acme integration
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: John Peters <john.peters@acme-corp.com>, security-ops@acme-corp.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence & transfer options for Acme integration

Hi John / Acme security team,

We're excited to move forward on the integration validation for Acme. To complete our security review and to satisfy your procurement checklist we typically need the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) or a bridge letter that covers the requested audit period. Quick asks below so we can hand this to my compliance team and close the loop: 

1) Audit window: Please confirm the date range for the SOC 2 Type II (start / end).
2) Report availability: Can you provide the full Type II report or a bridge letter? If redaction is required, indicate the allowed redaction level.
3) Transfer method: Which of these do you prefer for delivering artifacts? 
   - Pre-signed S3 link (7-day expiry)
   - SFTP drop (host + creds / key exchange)
   - Secure SharePoint / Box link
   - DocuSign for signatures (if needed)
4) Minimum deliverables: control narrative + auditor opinion page + complimentary bridge letter (if audit period doesn’t cover current quarter). Logs or longer telemetry samples are only needed if we call them out specifically.

For speed, I attached a bridge-letter template and a short evidence manifest (CSV) that lists the items we typically ask for. If it's easier, feel free to reply with one-line confirmation for any of the transfer methods and we'll open the intake path on our side.

If we don’t hear back in 48 hours I’ll follow up — we’re trying to align the compliance intake with our integration sprint next week.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_template.docx, evidence_manifest.csv

From: John Peters <john.peters@acme-corp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence & transfer options for Acme integration

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers from our side: 

- Audit window: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 (Type II).
- Report availability: We can provide a redacted PDF of the report and a signed bridge letter covering July 1 2026 to present if needed.
- Transfer: SFTP works for us; we can create a provisioned account and share host details. If Redwood prefers presigned S3, let me know and I’ll loop in infra.

Couple quick clarifying questions: 
1) Scope — which Redwood services are you validating? Hosted API only, or Hosted + Dedicated?
2) Retention — do you need raw logs or only control artifacts / policy snapshots?

If you can confirm scope and retention, I’ll ask our security ops to stage the SFTP drop and include the redacted report and bridge letter.

Regards,
John Peters
Head of Security Programs
Acme Corporation

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: John Peters <john.peters@acme-corp.com>, security-ops@acme-corp.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence & transfer options for Acme integration

Hi John — great, thanks for the audit window. Answers below and next steps: 

- Scope: Please include Hosted API (redwood.ai hosted inference endpoints) and Dedicated (reserved capacity) if possible. We flag both during procurement to make sure routing/fallbacks are covered. If only Hosted is in scope, please state that explicitly in the bridge letter.
- Retention / artifacts: At initial intake we only need the report (redacted ok), auditor opinion, control descriptions, and the bridge letter. We do not need production raw logs unless our security review calls them out later. If you prefer, include a short sample of telemetry (1 week) but mark it as optional.

Recommended transfer path (fastest): presigned S3 link (7 days). Alternate: SFTP (we can accept a one-time account) or secure SharePoint link. Once you confirm the transfer method I’ll open the intake ticket and provide upload credentials (if SFTP) or a presigned S3 endpoint.

One-line reply templates (feel free to paste back):
- "We will provide a redacted Type II report and bridge letter via presigned S3 by EOD 18-May-2026."
- "We will stage artifacts on SFTP; please share host and user/key and we will pull the package."
- "Hosted only — we can provide the report and bridge letter; Dedicated is not in scope."

I attached an evidence_manifest.csv to make staging easier. If you want, we can accept the initial package as: 1) redacted_report.pdf, 2) bridge_letter_signed.pdf, 3) control_narrative.pdf, 4) evidence_manifest.csv.

Thanks again — once you confirm transfer method I’ll post the intake ticket number and expected ETA on our side.

Best,
Irene
Security Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial evidence & transfer options for Acme integration

Hi John — looping in from Redwood compliance. Thank you for confirming the audit window. SFTP is fine; presigned S3 is also acceptable if you prefer. Next steps on our side: 

1) If you choose S3: please send a presigned upload link with 7-day expiry to this thread and we will download and import into our secure intake bucket.
2) If you choose SFTP: please provide host, username, and either a public key or temporary credentials. We will not store credentials in plain text — we will rotate keys after retrieval.

Expected ETA: once we receive the artifacts we will validate the manifest and ack receipt within 24 business hours. If everything looks good we’ll mark the compliance intake as complete and notify procurement to proceed.

For convenience I’ve attached the evidence_manifest.csv (same structure) — please use it when packaging. If you need a signed bridge letter sample we can adapt the attached template and return a signed copy.

Thanks — Naomi
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv
